tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Performs comprehensive code analysis with systematic investigation and expert validation. Use for architecture, performance, maintainability, and pattern analysis. Guides through structured code review and strategic planning.

step.description: The analysis plan. Step 1: State your strategy, including how you will map the codebase structure, understand business logic, and assess code quality, performance implications, and architectural patterns. Later steps: Report findings and adapt the approach as new insights emerge.

step_number.description: The index of the current step in the analysis sequence, beginning at 1. Each step should build upon or revise the previous one.

total_steps.description: Your current estimate for how many steps will be needed to complete the analysis. Adjust as new findings emerge.

next_step_required.description: Set to true if you plan to continue the investigation with another step. False means you believe the analysis is complete and ready for expert validation.

findings.description: Summary of discoveries from this step, including architectural patterns, tech stack assessment, scalability characteristics, performance implications, maintainability factors, and strategic improvement opportunities. IMPORTANT: Document both strengths (good patterns, solid architecture) and concerns (tech debt, overengineering, unnecessary complexity). In later steps, confirm or update past findings with additional evidence.

files_checked.description: List all files examined (absolute paths). Include even ruled-out files to track exploration path.

relevant_files.description: Subset of files_checked directly relevant to analysis findings (absolute paths). Include files with significant patterns, architectural decisions, or strategic improvement opportunities.

relevant_context.description: Methods/functions identified as involved in the issue

issues_found.description: Issues or concerns identified during analysis, each with severity level (critical, high, medium, low)

use_assistant_model.description: Use assistant model for expert analysis after workflow steps. False skips expert analysis, relies solely on your personal investigation. Defaults to True for comprehensive validation.

cli_name.description: Configured CLI client name. Defaults to codex; unavailable selections fail without fallback.

role.description: Configured subordinate expertise/style role. Defaults to default; tool instructions retain authority.

temperature.description: Legacy sampling setting; unsupported explicit values are unapplied with a warning.

thinking_mode.description: Legacy reasoning setting; unsupported explicit values are unapplied with a warning.

continuation_id.description: Unique thread continuation ID for multi-turn conversations. Works across different tools. ALWAYS reuse the last continuation_id you were given—this preserves full conversation context, files, and findings so the agent can resume seamlessly.

images.description: Optional absolute paths to architecture diagrams or visual references that help with analysis context.

model.description: Native CLI model identifier. Omitted, null, or auto uses role/client/native defaults. No provider alias translation.

confidence.description: Your confidence in the analysis: exploring, low, medium, high, very_high, almost_certain, or certain. 'certain' indicates the analysis is complete and ready for validation.

analysis_type.description: Type of analysis to perform (architecture, performance, security, quality, general)

output_format.description: How to format the output (summary, detailed, actionable)

step_number.description: Current step number in work sequence (starts at 1)

total_steps.description: Estimated total steps needed to complete work

next_step_required.description: Whether another work step is needed. When false, aim to reduce total_steps to match step_number to avoid mismatch.

findings.description: Important findings, evidence and insights discovered in this step

files_checked.description: List of files examined during this work step

relevant_files.description: Files identified as relevant to issue/goal (FULL absolute paths to real files/folders - DO NOT SHORTEN)

relevant_context.description: Methods/functions identified as involved in the issue

confidence.description: Confidence level: exploring (just starting), low (early investigation), medium (some evidence), high (strong evidence), very_high (comprehensive understanding), almost_certain (near complete confidence), certain (100% confidence locally - no external validation needed)

use_assistant_model.description: Use assistant model for expert analysis after workflow steps. False skips expert analysis, relies solely on your personal investigation. Defaults to True for comprehensive validation.

continuation_id.description: Unique thread continuation ID for multi-turn conversations. Works across different tools. ALWAYS reuse the last continuation_id you were given—this preserves full conversation context, files, and findings so the agent can resume seamlessly.

images.description: Optional paths to architecture diagrams or flow charts that help understand the tracing context.

trace_mode.description: Type of tracing: 'ask' (default - prompts user to choose mode), 'precision' (execution flow) or 'dependencies' (structural relationships)

target_description.description: Description of what to trace and WHY. Include context about what you're trying to understand or analyze.
